title: P1: Code mode merges two distinct MCP servers into one namespace
detail:
`packages/sigma/src/tools/mcp.ts:134`

Register separate MCP servers named `team-tools` and `team_tools`, then choose both for a ChatGPT conversation. Both normalize to `mcp__team_tools`. The code mode catalog combines both tool sets under the first server's description. `describeNamespace()` returns only the first server's instructions, so the model loses the other server's instructions.

Give each server its own unambiguous namespace and membership, or reject the ambiguous selection before startup.
